system.description:
The engine of your flying home.

Fast Travel (out of combat): Make a Power Roll (13) to start the fast travel mode of the spacecraft. On a success you fast travel to the next haven or planet. On a failure with fear the engine overheats and you have to wait 1d4 hours to try it again until then you float through space without drive or direction.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v3.0 Fist
